scope: Offline replay of saved Huber closed-loop simulated truth (ln k_eff) plus synthetic white observation noise; not fresh closed-loop evaluation.

data_audit.source_column_mapping: huber_windows.COLS=[0,1,2,3,5,11,14,18,21,26,27]; compact k_eff index 9 is source log column 26.
data_audit.validity: force > 0.5 N and k_eff > 0; scored after 1.5 s.

scan_direction.conclusion: All saved traces are monotonically increasing in scan position, so the field implementation’s high-edge-only entry assumption holds for these traces.

configuration.split: Even-indexed cases select global parameters on five main groups; odd-indexed cases held out. All-case results also reported. Group-best is retrospective.
